mutations.name: a runtime shutdown keeps its live runs' leases for a successor to wait out
kills: a serve stopped mid-step hands its run to the next serve a serve stopped with SIGTERM mid-step releases its lease, so the successor adopts the run and completes it

mutations.name: a completed post-merge step does not prune its chore files
kills: a serve stopped mid-step hands its run to the next serve a serve killed with SIGKILL mid-chore: the post-merge chore finishes in its own process and the successor records it
